assets.name: cafe
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production background image for Tick & Kin, a cozy companion focus timer app. Landscape 1536x1024. Full-bleed painted pixel-art environment with watercolor paper texture, delicate chunky pixel edges, warm miniature storybook game aesthetics. BACKGROUND ONLY: absolutely no people, animals, creatures, UI, timer, lettering, logos, border, device or mockup. Exact composition for app overlays: the animated character will be at x=22%, occupying x=10–36%, y=28–79%; leave that area uncluttered with no foreground objects. A broad horizontal floor/ground plane begins at y=79%, with a flat empty standing area at x=22%, y=79%. NO pedestal, no oval platform, no chairs, no furniture across this standing space. Concentrate charming environmental details at the far left edge and upper-left, and make the ENTIRE right 52% a softly lit, low-contrast, pale textured wall or mist area with no small objects: this is where the timer goes. Top 16% must remain relatively calm to sit behind the translucent header. Left and right flow into one continuous environment, no dividing line, no hard fade seam. Keep colors luminous and pale enough for blue-purple and brown app controls, avoid dark or high contrast surfaces on the right.
Scene: a cozy midnight bakery café for Jun, Bean and Maple. Honey oak floor across the bottom fifth, warm cream plaster, a moonlit arched window and small hanging copper lamp at far upper left, hints of ivy and a pastry shelf at the extreme left margin. Rich amber highlights on left, quiet warm ivory plaster on right. Open empty space behind character.
